claims.statement: The Ministry of Finance says KSeF issuing became mandatory on 1 February 2026 for the largest taxpayers and on 1 April 2026 for most others, while receiving through KSeF became mandatory from 1 February 2026.
The Ministry already provides free KSeF tools and permits access through any tool integrated with the KSeF 2.0 API, so basic issuance and retrieval alone is not a defensible paid product.
A cross-system exception layer may be valuable where free tools and incumbent ERPs do not reconcile operational, bank and ledger states.
The frequency and financial cost of unresolved KSeF exceptions in reachable SMEs is not yet known.

contrary_evidence: Free Ministry tools cover issuance and receipt, and established accounting and ERP vendors can add the same exception features.
Businesses with no more than 10,000 PLN gross of monthly invoiced sales retain a temporary issuing exemption through 2026, shrinking the smallest immediate segment.
KSeF is a compulsory workflow, but that fact alone does not prove a separate software budget.

economics.acquisition_route: Reach many end customers through accounting offices, Polish ERP implementers and tax advisers; lead with a no-write shadow audit that reports exceptions before asking for integration rights.
economics.founder_time: Part-time validation hypothesis; delivery burden remains untested.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A privacy-safe corpus of KSeF error signatures, system combinations, resolution steps and time-to-close can improve triage and make reseller support cheaper with every processed exception.
fingerprint.customer: Polish accounting offices and VAT-registered SMEs that receive or issue enough invoices to be inside mandatory KSeF, especially firms running an ERP, bank feed and accounting package that do not share one clean state.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Reach many end customers through accounting offices, Polish ERP implementers and tax advisers; lead with a no-write shadow audit that reports exceptions before asking for integration rights.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: An exception-first SaaS layer that polls KSeF, matches invoices to ERP, bank and ledger records, queues offline or failed submissions, assigns a resolution playbook and preserves an audit trail. Sell direct at a monthly entity fee and white-label to accounting offices or ERP resellers.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The accounting office or SME would pay per legal entity per month and by invoice-volume tier from its existing accounting or ERP operations budget. The product fee is proposed, not evidenced; the compulsory invoice flow is evidenced, while willingness to add another tool remains unknown.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Every received or issued invoice creates a compulsory digital workflow; schema rejections, offline-mode uploads, duplicates, missing attachments, supplier mistakes and mismatches against the ledger or bank become exception work rather than simple invoice creation.

founder_fit: Uses Polish context, data engineering and AI classification without requiring a personal brand.
Can begin as a read-only, low-capital tool and be tested alongside a full-time job.
A reseller model reduces repeated high-energy direct selling.
risks: Evidence of a workflow, transition, or loss does not yet establish recurring willingness to pay.
The proposed distribution and compounding mechanisms remain hypotheses pending buyer evidence.

title: KSeF exception and reconciliation autopilot for accounting offices
uncertainties: Which exception classes remain painful after ERP vendors finish their 2026 integrations?
Can accounting offices grant read-only API access without unacceptable security and professional-liability concerns?
What per-entity price is lower than the verified labor saved and reseller support burden?
Pricing, buyer authority, and acquisition economics remain unvalidated at discovery.

First validation test: Recruit 10 accounting offices covering at least 200 entities, ingest only permitted exports or read-only API data for 30 days, classify every exception and measure median staff minutes and unresolved value. Ask offices to pay for a second month only where the shadow audit demonstrates at least three times the proposed fee in saved labor or prevented correction work.
